rules.rule: Coupons are valid only on items marked 'coupon eligible'. Minimum cart value and category restrictions apply as per the coupon terms.
conditions: Minimum cart value must be met
Coupon must be applied before payment
exceptions: Already discounted items may not be eligible

rules.rule: Only one coupon can be applied per order. Coupons cannot be combined with flash sale prices or bank offers.
conditions: Customer must choose best applicable offer
exceptions: Bank offers may stack with select coupons during festivals (specified in T&C)

rules.rule: Expired coupons cannot be reactivated. Goodwill coupons issued by support are valid for 30 days from issuance.
conditions: Coupons must be used before expiry date

rules.rule: First-order coupons (e.g., WELCOME100) can only be used by new customers on their first paid order.
conditions: Account must have zero successful prior orders
Coupon code must be entered at checkout
exceptions: Cancelled orders do not count toward 'first order' status
